# forgebase_function (Data Source)

Looks up a function and its active version by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "forgebase_function" "hello" {
  name = "hello"
}

output "hello_version" {
  value = data.forgebase_function.hello.active_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docgen; do not edit by hand (run `go generate ./...`) -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Function name.

### Read-Only

- `access` (String) HTTP access mode.
- `active_version` (Number) Active version.
- `capabilities` (Set of String) Capabilities of the active version.
- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the active version's code.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) The function name.
- `language` (String) Language of the active version.
- `latest_version` (Number) Newest version.
- `principal` (String) Identity the function runs as.
- `updated_at` (String) Last change.
